card.name: Last digit before osmolarity or small units
card.fires_on: The last digit or letter of a number just before a unit such as mOsmol/L, mV, mrad or mSv. It is most common in osmolarity values of infusion solutions.

modes.label: Osmolarity digit
modes.description: Final digit of an osmolarity figure right before mOsmol/L.

modes.label: Milli- prefix of a unit
modes.description: The m that starts a milli unit such as mrad or mV, after a number or bracket.
modes.example: less than 300<<m>>V between connector and grounding busbar

card.writes: It promotes unit-like pieces such as psi, bar and ci, so it helps the model continue with a measurement unit.
card.plain: It fires on the end of a number just before a unit like mOsmol/L or mV, mostly in osmolarity statements.
